text:
zoe: starting a short relnotes thread. main items: embeddings API rename, small migration doc, snippet audit, and a couple of link fixes.
henry: tx. what's the embeddings rename?
kaya: alias change: `embed_stream` -> `embeddings.stream`. It's a breaking alias; we'll add a migration snippet and a deprecation timeline.
zoe: good. i'll draft docs/releases/embeddings-migration.md and link from relnotes. keep the migration tiny: 2 examples (py + js) and a timeline.
henry: i'll take python snippets. files to update: docs/sdk/python/embeddings.md and docs/tutorials/semantic-search.md. will open PR #4123.
kaya: i'll sweep JS examples and update docs/sdk/js/embeddings.md + examples/quickstart-js.md. PR #4124. also normalize comment headers to "Examples use SDK v0.14 / v1.2 / v0.6" depending on language.
docs-bot: PR #4123 opened by henry — python embedding snippet updates. PR #4124 opened by kaya — js embedding snippet updates.
morgan: discovered three broken anchor links after the TOC refactor in docs/guides/search.md, docs/sdk/js/reference.md, and docs/cli/flags.md. i'll patch them in a small PR.
zoe: add a Known Issues blurb: internal tests show rare JSON payload truncation when streaming embeddings + http proxies that buffer; workaround: switch to non-streaming embeddings or increase proxy buffer. add ticket ref (#560).
henry: noted. will include a short workaround snippet for nginx: set proxy_buffer_size and proxy_busy_buffers_size.
legal: quick heads-up: examples must not include real-looking customer IDs. replace values matching rwd_[0-9]{6,} with RWD_EXAMPLE_ID placeholder. also we should avoid any text implying SLA changes in relnotes.
kaya: will scrub example IDs. running grep. found 2 hits in examples/vecstore. opening PR #4126.
docs-bot: PR #4126 opened by kaya — scrub example ids and replace with placeholders.
morgan: for rollback ops: include the alias switch curl with alias `stable-prev-2026-02` and a note: "Switching aliases routes traffic instantly; expect up to 30s for caches to expire."
zoe: good. add this block in relnotes. also add a single-line "Docs hygiene checklist" in relnotes: no hardcoded keys, anchors verified, SDK versions normalized, placeholders used for example ids.
henry: small follow-up: some snippets still reference old class name ParamObj in python example libs. i'll convert to RequestParam in my PR.
kaya: in js i found functionName -> tool_name rename in some internal samples; migrating them too.
docs-bot: PR #4123 merged by henry. PR #4124 merged by kaya. PR #4126 merged by kaya.
morgan: i've pushed anchor fixes PR #4129; staging preview URL: https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/releases/embeddings-rename-preview. please sanity-check code rendering.
zoe: timeline? marketing needs relnotes by 10:00 PT tomorrow. can we merge migrate + relnotes by 22:00 PT tonight?
henry: yes if reviews are quick. i'll ping reviewers.
legal: one more tiny ask: add a single line in relnotes: "No changes to data retention or access controls." keeps customers calm.
zoe: will include. thanks. i'll finalize a short 3-bullet top section for marketing and link the migration doc with the code examples. ping when staging preview looks good.
